scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on his account and requesting a refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Scott Wagner and I'm 80. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello, Mr. Wagner. I understand how concerning it is to see an unrecognized charge, and I would be happy to look into this for you. To ensure your account security, may I please have your account number and the zip code associated with your billing address?
Sure, my account number is 8849-2021-4432 and I live in zip code 90210.

Thank you, Mr. Wagner. I have verified your identity. Looking at your transaction history, I see a charge for $76.00 from 'Global Digital Services' dated two days ago. Does that merchant name sound familiar at all?
No, that doesn't ring a bell. I've never heard of that company.

I appreciate you checking. Per our 'Unauthorized Transaction Policy', since you do not recognize the merchant, I have initiated a formal dispute for this transaction. I have also placed a temporary block on your card to prevent any further unauthorized activity.
Oh, that's a relief. Does that mean I get my money back now?

Yes, I have processed a provisional credit of $76.00 to your account, which will appear within 24 hours. A new card will be mailed to your address within 5-7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer, confirmed the unrecognized merchant, initiated a formal dispute, issued a provisional credit, and secured the account by replacing the card.
